title: 香蕉棒球Jesse Cole：前大联盟全明星也来打，球员凌晨排练七首原创歌
speaker: Jesse Cole

segments.en: Who do you target for this? Well, I'll tell you at first. Not many people wanted to play for us. They're like what is it? I think we had like 50 total people show up for the tryouts
segments.zh: 你们瞄准谁？一开始没多少人想为我们打球。他们问这是什么？我记得试训总共只来了50个人。

segments.en: Now we have thousands and we have from former major league all stars and world series champions like Jackie Bradley playing full-time. We got first round or second round. You have to play baseball at a very high level
segments.zh: 现在我们有几千人，有前大联盟全明星和世界大赛冠军，像Jackie Bradley全职打球。还有首轮或次轮秀。你必须打出非常高水平的棒球。

segments.en: I mean throw 90 95 miles an hour hit 400 foot home runs. But you have to be able to you know understand what it's about and that's entertainment
segments.zh: 投出90到95英里每小时，打出400英尺全垒打。但你必须理解这是娱乐。

segments.en: So our guys work. We've been doing rehearsals the last three days for hours early in the morning late at night. We've got brand new performances seven original songs a huge final inning show
segments.zh: 我们的球员很努力。过去三天我们排练了好几个小时，从清晨到深夜。我们有全新的表演、七首原创歌曲、盛大的最后一局秀。

segments.en: So you have to understand that you got to do things get out of your comfort zone. And yes, they every day their practicing trick play is catching the ball between the legs and back flips. So they have taken their baseball ability to another level and push themself to another level. And I think those are the players we look for every single night. I mean
segments.zh: 所以你必须明白要走出舒适区。他们每天练习胯下接球和后空翻。他们把棒球能力提升到另一个层次，逼自己突破。这就是我们每晚寻找的球员。
